license.declared_note: TODO-verify with whoever owns publication terms before the first probe set lands. Synthetic items generated in-house have no upstream terms to inherit, so a declared license is honest here in a way it is not for the corpus families - but 'declared' means somebody actually declared it, and CC-BY-4.0 is a proposal until they do. If nobody will decide, change basis to 'unknown' rather than leaving an unbacked declaration; section 3 is explicit that an unchecked field manufactures unearned confidence.

defaults.validation_not_required_because: A probe is entirely held out by construction: anything trained on stops being a probe. The whole artifact is the test split.

notes: Synthetic diagnostic task sets built to isolate one mechanism: S5 parity under solvable versus non-solvable conditions, multi-hop retrieval at a controlled depth, memory-split dense-versus-sparse comparisons. Distinguished from eval by intent - an eval set measures general capability against a public benchmark, a probe is constructed to make one specific hypothesis falsifiable, so its defining axis is the CONDITION being varied and names must carry it (probe/s5-parity-solvable, probe/multihop-wikidata-4hop; see DATASET-STANDARD.md section 2). Profile default is eval-items/v1, which requires a stable per-item id - load-bearing here because a probe's whole value is paired comparison across conditions and arms, and that is impossible if item identity is positional. Partition default is a single 'test' split: a probe is entirely held out by construction, and anything trained on stops being a probe. reproducibility defaults to 'bitwise' - the ONLY family where that is an honest default, because these items are generated by a seeded program with no upstream corpus, no filtering that depends on wall-clock, and no model in the loop. Section 3 warns that declaring bitwise falsely is the same class of error as the .npy lie, so if a generator ever grows a model call or a nondeterministic dependency, drop this to 'logical' in that dataset. Derive per-item randomness as sha256(domain || seed || stable_id) per section 3's domain-separated seeds rule, so that reordering generation stages does not silently rewire the RNG stream and regenerate a different item under the same id. Items are gzipped JSONL and counted in items, not rows or tokens: the unit is the diagnostic question, whatever its internal shape.
